description: This file sets up the testing environment for an Ember.js application using QUnit and ember-qunit, importing necessary helpers, initializing the application, and starting the test runner.

methods.name: setApplication
methods.description: Initializes the Ember application for testing with the provided application instance.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Configures QUnit assertions with DOM helpers from 'qunit-dom'.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the Ember QUnit test runner.
